title: Rav Chanina bar Rav Katina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Gittin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.38a.18), Rav Chanina bar Rav Katina speaks in the name of R’ Yitzchak. At [Gittin 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.43b.5), Hyman reads Rav Huna bar R’ Katina. Hyman gives Rav Acha bar Katina as the reading at Yevamot 26a.[^1]

notes.text: Gittin 43b gives Rav Huna bar Katina without a title for his father. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=960&lang=en) also compares the two Gittin notices. The proposed Yevamot form has not been confirmed at the supplied folio.
